flags.why: The example mentions the expression itself instead of using it to refer to breasts.
flags.fix: Nó cứ nhìn chằm chằm vào vú vê của người ta. = He keeps staring at other people's boobs.

flags.why: The common sense of civilised behaviour or good manners, as in cư xử có văn hoá, is missing ([dictionary](https://tratu.soha.vn/dict/vn_vn/V%C4%83n_ho%C3%A1)).
The example explains what the word denotes instead of using it in context.
flags.fix: Anh ấy thích chơi vũ cầu. = He likes playing badminton.

flags.why: The archaic tag misleadingly suggests the term is obsolete, although it still appears in contemporary usage ([school programme](https://lsts.edu.vn/images/uploads/2026/04/02/20260402044554234_a01bcc22-bd88-4658-ba04-393b80209187.pdf)).
The example defines the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Vương thái hậu bước vào điện. = The queen dowager entered the palace hall.

flags.fix: Nhà vua đến thăm mẹ mình, Vương đại phi. = The king visited his mother, the queen mother.
